comments.value: Can confirm. Whenever the editor is repainted the VRCPipelineManagerEditor OnInspectorGUI runs ApiCredentials.Load(). This appears to be the cause of the lag.
Agree. Have the same problem. SDK 2018.12.19.17.03
This is still a very annoying issue two months later on SDK build 2019.03.07.12.19
Holy shit you fixed my lag issue. I've had this unbearable lag for almost a full year now in my unity editor.
Not sure but that seem to be fixed ? @{58c62e995865713647a7115b|full_name}
Fixed with a new SDK provided alongside VRChat 2019.3.1! https://vrchat.com/download/sdk

details:
The "pipeline manager" component is automatically added to Avatar Descriptors and Scene Descriptors. While this component is visible and expanded, Unity lags like crazy. Even typing in a text box (such as to adjust the avatar's viewpoint) lags.

Collapsing the component *immediately* stops the lag and makes the editor very smooth again.
title: Pipeline Manager component lags Unity
